quotes.text: Provide customer balance funding instructions without creating a PaymentIntent.

To create or retrieve funding instructions for a customer-configured [Account](https://docs.stripe.com/api/v2/core/accounts/object.md#v2_account_object-configuration-customer), use the Customers API endpoint with the `Account` ID as the path parameter, for example `v1/customers/acct_xxxxx/funding_instructions`.

To provide your customer with proof of account ownership, [download a bank account ownership letter](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance/funding-instructions/account-ownership-letter.md).

This is a scoped documented schema/network-list change, not proof every customer receives CHAPS-capable details or that a transfer succeeded.

Do not treat preview access as universal or conflate Account ID and Customer object.

The linked child's contents were not pinned; preserve May UI/PDF details as dated.

The November US response lists distinct ABA and SWIFT financial-address types (new raw lines 106-159), illustrating why address/set identity must be preserved. The same source line says test details are 'invalid (non-unique)' as if always non-unique; both raw captures say invalid test/sandbox details might not always be unique (old raw line 32; new raw line 33). Source line 29 adds 'per account' to the 1000 SEPA VBAN fee inclusion, but the raw states only that fees in SEPA include up to 1000 VBANs (old raw lines 72-98; new raw lines 55-70), without an explicit per-account denominator.

historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain May 5, 2026 Node.js createFundingInstructions examples as dated SDK examples for US/UK/EU/JP/MX and distinguish November curl form of the same v1 Customers endpoint (old raw lines 34-136; new raw lines 35-90). answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance/funding-instructions, the complete November guide says to provide a customer funding details before the first payment without creating a PaymentIntent: create or view a currency cash balance in Dashboard, or use the v1 Customers funding_instructions API with funding_type=bank_transfer, regional type and currency to obtain financial_addresses/supported_networks (new raw lines 5-33, 35-90). The May guide documents the same purpose and regional examples in Node.js (old raw lines 4-32, 34-136). US ABA/SWIFT, UK sort_code, EU IBAN/BIC, JP zengin and MX SPEI/CLABE are distinct address formats; November adds CHAPS to the UK list (new raw lines 98-301; old raw lines 138-346). For a customer-configured Account, November says pass its Account ID through the Customers endpoint, subject to Accounts v2 Connect GA or other-user preview/version conditions (new raw lines 92-97). source-stripe-customer-balance-funding-instructions.md maps the older schema but omits CHAPS and Accounts v2, calls the live-mode unique set of bank-transfer details a unique VBAN, overstates test non-uniqueness and 1000 VBANs 'per account', and lacks November provenance (current source lines 1-37; old raw line 32; new raw lines 33, 106-159). Funding instructions and address display are not a bank transfer, reconciliation, PaymentIntent success, or funds availability.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance/funding-instructions, the change from May Node.js examples to November curl and table formatting is mainly presentational; the substantive documented deltas are UK CHAPS in the sort_code supported_networks and an Accounts v2 customer-configured Account ID route with Connect GA/other-user preview and preview-version qualification (new raw lines 35-97, 172-181; old raw lines 34-136, 214-222). The ownership-letter workflow moved from detailed May Dashboard PDF steps to a November child link, which does not prove the steps changed (new raw lines 303-305; old raw lines 348-363). source-stripe-customer-balance-funding-instructions.md should retain May route and dated Node.js detail, add November raw/canonical_url, describe a unique live-mode set of bank-transfer details rather than one VBAN, preserve 'might not always be unique' for invalid sandbox details, and remove its unsupported 'per account' 1000-VBAN denominator (current source lines 1-9, 17-37; old raw lines 32, 72-98; new raw lines 33, 55-70, 106-159). The concept's 'ES unavailable' at wiki/concepts/stripe-customer-balance.md line 69 must narrow to new localized VBAN creation (old raw line 98; new raw line 70); concept line 23 must scope Accounts v2 retrieval by Connect GA versus other-user preview/version (new raw lines 92-96). Account versus Customer IDs, live versus sandbox validity, regional address networks, and creating instructions versus incoming/reconciled funds remain separate; no account-specific eligibility or successful transfer is proven.
